description.value:
You choose a point on the ground within range, and everything in a 15-foot radius bursts into flame. Each creature there must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 8d8 fire damage, taking half as much on a success; Large or smaller creatures that fail are pushed to the edge of the affected area.

You may designate one creature to stand at the very center of the blast, and that creature has disadvantage on its save and is knocked prone if it fails.

Cast with a tech slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 and the radius by 5 feet for each slot level above 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
